Handling if value of the received Offset Value in units of 16 bytes do not match to the sum of the received Payload bytes of the previous SOME/IP TP segments If the API SomeIpTp_RxIndication() is called, the SOME/IP TP module shall check the value of the Offset Field at the corresponding PDU per identified transmission source ([SWS_SomeIpTp_00096].
